# Mauro Gomez - Full Stack Developer

> Full stack developer. Backend in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA) and frontend in React; currently learning Rust (Tokio, Axum, Actix Web, SQLx, Serde, Odra). Studies at UPATECO. 1st place in the Football Challenge at the Argentina Space 2026 Hackathon and 2nd place at the PunaTech Hackathon. Open to work.

## Featured projects
- Brand mascot: NODUS, an original mecha character.
- Achique: live blocking of pirate streams with a duty judge who approves and signs every order (Python, standard library only). 1st place, Football Challenge, Argentina Space 2026 Hackathon. https://achique-g8j6.onrender.com , https://github.com/Maurezg7/achique
- Trasluz: confidential B2B settlement on Avalanche eERC with a read-only window for the auditor (Solidity, React, wagmi). Avalanche track, Argentina Space 2026 Hackathon. https://trasluz-2av.pages.dev , https://github.com/Maurezg7/trasluz
- Dengue Centinela: dengue risk heat map for Salta from WhatsApp reports (React 19, TanStack Start, Express, Prisma). Not deployed. https://github.com/EstebanNahuelok/dengue-centinela
- Cazatalentos: on-chain record of early artist backers (Solidity, React, NestJS, Monad). https://cazatalentos.vercel.app/ , https://github.com/Maurezg7/cazatalentos
- SEM Salta: metered parking payments with MercadoPago (NestJS, React). 2nd place, PunaTech Hackathon.
- Hermes: company management platform (Java, Spring Boot, Angular).
- YieldVault: autonomous yield agent smart contract in Rust (Odra, Casper).
